photo.facesHint: Keep faces out of the picture
photo.guideFrame: Fit the item inside the frame
photo.cameraOff: The camera is off. Start it, or use a file.
photo.cameraLive: Camera on. Take the photo when the item is in the frame.
photo.cameraDenied: The camera is blocked for this page. Allow it in the browser, or use a file.
photo.cameraUnavailable: There is no camera here. Use a file instead.
photo.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it, or use a file.
photo.cameraFailed: The camera did not start. Try again, or use a file.
photo.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read as a photo. Choose another one.
photo.undoNothing: There is no mark to undo
photo.clearNothing: There are no marks to clear
photo.prepareFailed: The photo could not be prepared. Try again.
photo.instructions: Drag on the photo to draw, or tap to mark a spot. With the keyboard: the arrow keys move the crosshair (Shift moves further), Enter sets the start, Enter again draws the mark, Escape cancels it.
photo.startArrow: Arrow start set at {at}. Move to where it points and press Enter.
photo.startCircle: Circle centre set at {at}. Move to its edge and press Enter.
photo.tooShort: Move the crosshair away from the start first.

lab.labelDock: Photo of the delivery at the dock
lab.required: Circle the problem first: the inspector reads the photo, not a note.
lab.readOnly: Only quality inspectors add photos to an inspection. You can look at the photos already there.
lab.offline: Offline — the photo waits in this tablet's queue and is sent when the connection is back.
lab.waiting: Use photo hands the photo to the screen; the part sends nothing itself.
lab.got: The screen got a {width} × {height} photo with {marks}; it uploads it to the record's files now.
lab.queued: The screen got a {width} × {height} photo with {marks}; it waits in the queue until the connection is back.
lab.cancelled: Cancelled: the step closes and nothing is kept.
